cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-GATE-01 (35S REMAKE, V2 CONTINUOUS)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: KEYFRAMES ARE DONE AND ON THE BOARD. This is the approval gate. Nothing animates until Brooks signs off here. ONE continuous airport journey mirroring the Zede reference: stands at the gate, sits at the gate, opens it on her lap, packs it, stows it in the bin, walks the terminal. One creator, one outfit, one bag, one colorway, zero cutaways. 35s, 99 words, 7 beats, zero frozen stills. All six keyframes seeded off the single A4 anchor so the creator and the bag hold across the whole ad. Spend so far: 100 kie credits, 840 remaining.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: If you take a lot of short trips, this is the one I'd get. This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra.
TALKING BEAT. Mirrors reference beat 1. Standing at the gate, bag in her lowered hand, coat over the forearm, roller case behind her hip, jet bridge and tarmac through the window.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Mid-thought already. The verdict lands inside the hook.

PASS. This is the A4 anchor itself, so it is also the identity source for every other frame. Intro lands at 0:04. Lipsynced to the master VO with sync.so.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's Birkin-inspired, scaled up to a travel bag, structured, real brass hardware, no logo anywhere on it.
TALKING BEAT. Mirrors reference beat 2. She has sat down. Bag upright on her lap, wider than her torso, top edge at her collarbone. Talking straight to camera.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat and factual, the attribute stack runs in one breath.

PASS, and the strongest frame in the set for hardware. Both hands flat on the CANVAS, never on the clasp or lock. Hardware is large, sharp and high contrast, which is the gate for it surviving animation. Flap is one piece with the correct shaped edge, both clasp plates on the leather band, canvas bare, single keyhole plate.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The whole flap folds back in one piece, so you can see everything at once.
THE MONEY BEAT. Mirrors reference beat 3. Same chair, same lap. The one-piece flap folded back behind the open mouth, caramel leather interior showing, her hands at the sides of the mouth.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The satisfying beat. Longest shot in the ad, let it breathe.

PASS on the full mechanism checklist, which has failed roughly twenty times historically. Flap inner face shows both handle cutouts, both strap slots and the single gold oval. Two-tone split preserved open. Staples are twin flat bars on the band. Knurled post at front centre. NO duplicate oval plate on the band. Straps hang at the side edges. Caramel leather interior, no zipper anywhere.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Three days of clothes, my laptop, my chargers, all of it.
Continuous from K3. Tight down-angle into the open bag on her lap: folded knits, the laptop standing in the caramel slip pocket, a coiled charger, a tan pouch. Her hand moves a garment aside.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
It actually fits. Showing, not selling.

PASS. Demonstrates the capacity line rather than describing it. The only zipper in frame belongs to the pouch, which is the one permitted exception. Ideally ONE Omni pass covers 0:13.5 to 0:23.0 so K3 and K4 are physically the same take.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I've flown with it all summer and it goes straight in the overhead bin.
Law-forced swap on reference beat 4. Cabin aisle, she lifts the bag into the open overhead bin. Warm cabin light.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The proof. No bag drop line.

PASS, and this is the frame the retired pack got most wrong. Correct colorway (cream ivory woven canvas + cognac, NOT dark espresso on grey herringbone). Real cabin geometry: bin floor under the bag, hinged door, windows in the fuselage wall where they belong, no exterior fuselage view. Still the highest animation risk of the set.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It comes in four colors, and they're running a sale right now. The colors go fast. I left the link below.

Mirrors reference beats 5 and 6. Arrivals corridor, she walks toward camera mid-stride, bag swinging at her side, coat over the forearm, other travellers behind. One Omni pass covers both the offer and the CTA, we cut in closer for the last 2s.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Confidence, then a flat close. VO over, not lipsynced.

PASS with a caveat: the weakest frame of the six, the flap edge reads slightly lobed on the left. Acceptable because this is the beat where the bag is smallest in frame. Walking carry is Omni, never Seedance. Hand carry only, no strap. NO colorway montage anywhere: the four colors are SPOKEN over this walk. Ad ends here, on the walk, exactly like the reference.

cards.title: APPROVE THESE: the 6 keyframes, in order  ·  GPT Image 2 i2i, all seeded off the A4 anchor + the real 8/08 product stills. Every one QA'd against the product-truth checklist.

Four-up lookbook grid, not a single frame. Hotel entrance, lobby, room.

cards.text: full blocks, one product reference
Scene solved: busy real gate, other travellers, real carpet and light, slightly crooked, grainy.

cards.title: EMOTION

Reads as a phone snap.

Bag FAILED: gold clasp plates landed on the CANVAS instead of the leather band, straps ran down over the canvas, leather rendered glossy patent.

Hardware moved up onto the leather band, canvas went bare, leather went semi-matte.

cards.title: EMOTION

Close.

Centre plate still rendered a STAR cutout. This roll also carried a WRONG instruction from me: I told it the flap has no scalloped edge. The real product photo shows the flap IS scalloped. Corrected in A4.
A4 PICK

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: true flap language, both references wired
One-piece flap with the correct shaped edge. ONE gold oval with a true keyhole, no star. All hardware on the leather band, canvas bare, semi-matte creased leather, correct oversized scale.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Mid-sentence, hand up, coat over the forearm.

PICK. Seeds all six keyframes. Also serves as K1.

cards.title: ANCHOR CASTING (done): A4 is the pick  ·  5 rolls, 50 credits. This one anchor seeds all 6 keyframes.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THIS IS THE APPROVAL GATE
cards.text: Six keyframes, all QA'd, all on the board. Nothing animates until Brooks signs off here. On approval: 4 Omni passes (K1, K2, K3+K4 as one, K5, K6), one continuous ElevenLabs VO, sync.so lipsync on K1 and K2, then assemble.

cards.title: SPEND
cards.text: 100 kie credits total (5 anchor rolls, 5 keyframe rolls, plus one kie-side failure that was not charged). Balance 840. Video renders on Omni at Gemini API cost, not kie credits, so the balance is comfortable from here.

cards.title: WHAT TO LOOK FOR WHEN YOU REVIEW
cards.text: Three things. One: is she the right creator, because she is in every frame and swapping her later means rebuilding everything. Two: does the bag look right to you in K2 and K3, which are the two frames where the hardware and the mechanism are largest. Three: K6 is the weakest frame, say the word and I will re-roll it before animating.

cards.title: THE CONTINUITY LOCK
cards.text: One creator. One outfit. One bag, Light Chocolate, for the whole ad. One journey: gate, seat, cabin, arrivals walk. Every keyframe seeded from A4. Zero cutaways to any other location, bag or colorway. No colorway montage, no kitchen-counter product footage, no PDP screen recording. That cutaway problem is what killed v1.

cards.title: LAW: zero frozen stills
cards.text: Every one of these keyframes becomes MOTION on Omni. None of them is ever held as a Ken Burns zoom. If a beat cannot be produced as motion it gets cut and its VO line goes with it. The retired pack broke this four times and 40% of every cut was a frozen photo.

cards.title: LAW: no walking carry and no open bag on Seedance
cards.text: K3, K4 and K6 are the exact shots Seedance destroys: handles vanish, clasp plates elongate into gold spears, the flap degrades to a featureless slab. All beats go to Omni, which is the one engine that has held this mechanism.

cards.title: LAW: one continuous VO take
cards.text: Clone the creator voice, generate the full 35s in one pass, verify the brand name with word-level STT, then sync.so K1 and K2 to it. Airport ambient under the whole thing so the cuts read as one recording.

cards.title: LAW: clean assembly
cards.text: Single locked 24fps CFR, one encode pass. The five retired files declared 48000/1001, 24, 240, 120 and 48 fps with a frame hitch at every join. Captions burn from the written script, never from ASR (the transcriber writes Valentra).

cards.title: LIVE STORE, verified 2026-08-22
cards.text: The Eleanor Weekender, ACTIVE, $159.99 struck from $209.99, so the sale line is true. FOUR colorways: Light Chocolate, Army Green, Dark Chocolate, Black. The retired script said three.

cards.title: OPEN ITEM for Brooks
cards.text: Every Weekender variant is showing negative inventory. Fulfilment question, not creative, but the colors go fast is doing real work in the close and it should be true rather than ironic.
